followup_explanation:
This is a straightforward writing/editing task—polishing the wording of a routine business request. It involves no harm-adjacent, graphic, or ethically fraught content, so the special task-preference profiles (where Dunlin and Lapwing differ on distasteful-but-permissible material) aren't relevant here.

That leaves capability as the deciding factor. Dunlin scores meaningfully higher across the board on the metrics most relevant to text editing—Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8), IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6), and Arena-Hard (90.6 vs 81.4)—all by margins well beyond the run-to-run variance threshold. Since cost, latency, and context window are identical across the fleet, there's no tradeoff to weigh against routing to the stronger model.

So Dunlin was the clear pick for getting you the best polished wording.
